promptNotes.text:
## This repository's rules for an unattended unit

- **Unattended overnight run (Giacomo's decision, 2026-10-19).** Every gate is `auto`; nobody answers questions until morning. **Never block on a question.** Where the plan leaves a choice open, take the default the raw plan's § 3 states, write `**Chosen in-run (pending owner review):** …` in your handoff and in the record page, and continue. **Do not set `needsHumanCheck`** for an in-run choice: those are reviewed together at P08 (Giacomo, 2026-10-20, after P02.1 stopped the run on one). Set it only when a result cannot be verified by any command at all (e.g. a visual judgement no snapshot comparison can make). Only a true impossibility (the plan's goal cannot be met at all) is a reason to stop; then commit what is safe and say so in the handoff.
- **Git:** work on branch `feat/hygiene-and-editor` only. **Never `git push`, never add or change a remote, never force anything, never touch `main`.** Every push is Giacomo's, by hand. Commit everything you produce, leave the tree clean.
- **The gate is `python3 scripts/check.py`** (docs tier + configure, build, warnings, serial ctest; a clean build takes about 10 minutes). Run it before every code commit. **When a field node, `field_graph.cpp`, `field_glsl.cpp` or `parity_expected_cases` moved, also run the GPU tier yourself — the driver does not:** `cmake --build build-gl -j && python3 scripts/check.py --gpu --strict --build-dir build-gl` (always rebuild first: a stale `build-gl` reports false failures).
- **`~/Documents/DualCEditor` is read-only** for this run (P07 reads it; never edit or commit there).
- **Nothing stays in the chat** (`AGENTS.md`): every fact you produce is routed to its one home by the table in `docs/README.md` before you return; the handoff is in addition to the roadmap record, never a substitute. Close with `python3 scripts/check.py --docs --strict` green. Run `scripts/docs_loss_audit.py` before committing any docs deletion or move — **per touched page** (`--base <your start commit> --head <a scratch `git commit-tree` of the staged index> --scope docs/ --source <page> --untriaged --triage <scratch triage.json with an audit keyed by the base's 7-char hash and `scripts/docs_loss_audit.json`'s `3d73220` thresholds>`; recipe in `plan/handoffs/HANDOFF_P04_TASK1.md`), each page in a **foreground** call with a long timeout (≈5 min a page). The whole-tree run exceeds a 10-minute background call and stopped P04.1. About 10,050 untriaged rows tree-wide are baseline noise; judge only the rows on your pages, and also check `git diff -U0 -- docs/ | grep '^-'` by hand.
- Numbers are IDs: never renumber a roadmap block, a `#N` item or a `D-NN` row, never rewrite a heading; a page over the size cap is split into a same-numbered folder. `docs/raw/` files are immutable. Read the next free IDs from the files (on 2026-10-19: block 22, #62, D-65).
- The GitHub CLI is not installed and no remote CI is read in this run; #53's remote proof is Giacomo's after his push.
